diagnostics.message: The EKS add-on consumes the IRSA role ARN, but that reference waits for role creation only; it does not ensure the IRSA policy attachment is complete before EKS starts the add-on, so the add-on can initialize without its required permissions.

The EKS add-on consumes the IRSA role ARN, but that reference waits for role creation only; it does not ensure the IRSA policy attachment is complete before EKS starts the add-on, so the add-on can initialize without its required permissions.

The EventBridge target can be created after the queue but before its resource policy permits EventBridge to send messages. Make the target wait for the SQS queue policy to avoid an unauthorized or unusable target.
This direct dependency is redundant because the wait resource already depends on the provider manifest, so the provider-config manifest is transitively ordered after it through the wait resource.
